scenario: presentationFor(type) for every DISTINCT open type value recognize() emits across tests/fixtures/bundles/okf-sample/. presentationFor is adapter-agnostic (keyed purely on the open type string, spec §2/§3.4), so an OKF concept's type can coincide with an AKM KNOWN_TYPE and pick up its presentation, or -- for a genuinely foreign vendor type -- fall through to the generic DEFAULT_PRESENTATION.
adapterStatus: IMPLEMENTED — src/core/adapter/adapters/okf-adapter.ts (doc.ownsPresentation = true, per its own file header: 'the owning adapter provides the complete generic presentation projection'). presentationFor itself lives in src/core/type-presentation.ts and is shared across every adapter.
specSource: docs/architecture/specs/akm-0.9.0-bundle-adapter-spec.md §2 ('Renderer/action = data table keyed on the open type ... lookup stays open-string with a generic fallback'), §3.4 ('No closed set replaces AkmAssetType ... any other type renders generically and stays searchable').
realWorldSource: src/core/type-presentation.ts#presentationFor / DEFAULT_PRESENTATION = {label: 'Asset'} (no renderer key -- undefined, not the JSON `null` recorded below; the consumer test normalizes `p.renderer ?? null` before comparing, mirroring website-snapshot-adapter.test.ts's identical pattern for the same reason)
notes: 'knowledge' IS one of AKM's own KNOWN_TYPES (the default OKF assigns when a concept's frontmatter carries no type: field, §5.1) -- it picks up the SAME TYPE_PRESENTATION entry ('knowledge-md' renderer) that an AKM-native knowledge/*.md file would get. This is the mirror image of website-snapshot's golden, whose 'website' type is NOT a KNOWN_TYPE and falls through to the generic default -- here, one of the two OKF sample types happens to collide with a KNOWN_TYPE and one does not, demonstrating both branches of presentationFor's open-string lookup from a single real fixture.

'Metric' and 'BigQuery Table' (Google's own OKF vocabulary, §GA4 sample bundle) are NOT AKM KNOWN_TYPES -- both resolve to DEFAULT_PRESENTATION (label 'Asset', no renderer), same as website-snapshot's 'website'. Third-party/foreign OKF type values are never dropped -- they stay searchable and render generically via the fallback `akm show <ref>` action (§3.4).
